title: ManagerDecision
description: Append-only record of one manager decision extracted from a session (Task 168). Raw manager statements are preserved verbatim; redaction runs before persistence and redaction_verified attests the stored text is clean.

decision_id.description: Stable id, e.g. DEC-20260908-001. Date part is the record date, sequence is zero-padded per day.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the decision was recorded.

project_name.description: Project the decision belongs to (e.g. cognitive-lead-hq).

session_id.description: Owning session/task linkage, e.g. task id '167' or transcript path.

verbatim_quote.description: Original manager statements, NEVER summarized away.

original.description: Verbatim manager statement in its source language.

english_translation.description: Faithful English translation of the original.

rationale.description: Why the manager decided this way (as stated or inferred, marked as such).

alternatives.description: Options the manager explicitly considered and rejected.

tradeoffs.description: Cost/benefit the manager accepted with this decision.

redaction_verified.description: True only when verify_clean() passed on every persisted free-text field.
